'''Hendric Faile''' was the fleet commander of the [[Kathol Republic Navy]], and commanded the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] ''[[Triumph]]''. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Faile responded to a distress call from the ''[[Bravado III]]'' following the [[Battle of Episol]]. Discovering the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' also on the scene, he ordered the vessel to stand down and prepare for boarding since all evidence pointed to the New Republic being responsible for the crippling of the ''Bravado III''. He oversaw the capture of the vessel, using [[Kathol Republic Marines|marines]] from his ship, and took the corvette and crew to [[Dayark]].
